title: Prime Minister expresses grief over loss of lives in mishap in Khunti, Jharkhand
body_text: The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has expressed deep anguish over the loss of lives in a mishap in Khunti, Jharkhand. The Prime Minister conveyed his condolences to those who have lost their loved ones and prayed for the speedy recovery of the injured. The Prime Minister’s Office wrote on X; “Deeply pained by the loss of lives in a mishap in Khunti, Jharkhand. I extend my condolences to those who have lost their loved ones. Praying for the speedy recovery of the injured: PM @narendramodi” Deeply pained by the loss of lives in a mishap in Khunti, Jharkhand. I extend my condolences to those who have lost their loved ones.
